arguments.summary: P17 has provided guidance on the issue. They mentioned that pgbouncer is the Postgres server and it listens on port 8081. They also noted that timeouts usually indicate a full disk, and suggested flushing the CDN cache if lookups are stale. Additionally, they pointed out the growing backlog in the failed-jobs table in the jobs database. Further investigation into why jobs are failing is needed, along with exporting the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. They also stressed not to delete any rows, as they will be handled by P17. The recommended next step is to investigate the growing backlog and export the failed_jobs table.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the growing backlog in the failed-jobs table and export the failed_jobs table for the postmortem.
